items.html: And the matter is that in AA there is no separate female apart from him; rather, his entire right side is male, and his entire left side is female. And it is found that likewise his Yesod is composed of male and female, like the date-palm, in the secret of "the righteous shall flourish like a date-palm." And its right half is male and its left half is female, and this is the discernment of the Yesod, male, and the discernment of its crown, female, for the crown is the discernment of the Malchut of AA. And then the right half is given into the Yesod of Aba, which is also male, in the secret of Mayin Duchrin [male waters], and the left half into the Yesod of Ima, which is also female, in the secret of MAN [Mayin Nukvin].
